newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Rate on 91-day Cyprus bills unchanged at 5.49 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rate on 91-day Cyprus bills unchanged at 5.49 pct.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus on Wednesday sold 55 million pounds ($106.5 million) worth of 91 day treasury bills with an average yield of 5.49 percent, unchanged from the rate at the last auction held on June 25.
The bills have a July 2 issue date.
The central bank said competitive and non competitive bids totalled 66 million pounds. It accepted competitive bids worth 50 million pounds, and non competitive bids worth five million pounds.
Yields ranged from 5.50 percent to 5.45 percent, the bank said in a statement. ($=0.516 pounds)
